qualification.package: Clean public wheel/sdist, focused CPU checks, unprivileged image imports, matching visible source and default pipeline CLI verified. Images reuse immutable published 0.7.0 dependencies and install the selected wheel offline. No model weights are bundled.
qualification.engine: Owned two-step repaint executed two complete five-second scenes on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server with application-owned FP8 loaders and explicit 44 sparse / 6 dense attention. One legacy/native two-step pair matched all 120 decoded frames. The supported 44/6 repaint code is unchanged by removal of the rejected zero-dense option.
qualification.limits: Installed public images have CPU/dependency/CLI verification, not a new GPU image matrix. Two-step repaint is approximate against four steps, not a general perceptual or full-request latency guarantee. Veda, FROST, restoration models and prepared tables require explicit provisioning. Zero dense-edge layers are unsupported. Consuming service deployment is separate.
